text:
Ava: Quick heads-up — found 2 orphan links while doing a small sweep of onboarding/runbook. One shortlink returns 404 and a gist used in the runtime examples was deleted. Can someone pick this up? @Sam? :eyes:

Sam: I can take the onboarding shortlink. Which files exactly?

Ava: Paths: `docs/onboarding/quickstart.md` and `docs/runtime/examples/curl.md`. Failing check output: ```
$ curl -I https://short.ly/rw-onboard
HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
```
Also the gist at `https://gist.github.com/old-snippet/abcd` 404s.

Sam: Thanks. Plan: replace the shortlink with the canonical docs URL and rehost the gist content into `docs/snippets/curl-onboard.md` (so CI can include it). Will run the link-checker locally before PR. ETA: EOD today.

Ravi: FYI `docs/onboarding/quickstart.md` is in the platform codeowner set. If it's purely a link swap, that's fine, but if you're embedding the gist we should ping the platform reviewers for a quick sanity check.

Lena: I can review from oncall side — prefer embedding the snippet rather than depending on external gists. Small PR is ok; please include updated frontmatter and a changelog line.

Sam: Got it. Rehost plan: copy gist into `docs/snippets/curl-onboard.md` and reference via include. I ran `scripts/link-checker` locally (output below) and fixed one stray trailing slash. Will open PR now.

Ava: Nice — also add a short note in the runbook about persistent links (we want canonical docs links, not shortlinks).

Sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3216 — title: "docs: replace expired shortlink and rehost curl gist". Summary: replace shortlink with stable path, add `docs/snippets/curl-onboard.md`, update frontmatter, and add link-check CI smoke test. PTAL @Lena @Ravi.

docs-bot: link-checker: running on PR #3216 (CI job started) :hammer_and_wrench:

docs-bot: link-checker: 0 broken links found, 1 warning (trailing slash normalized).

Lena: LGTM for content. Small nit about wording in the snippet, but not blocking.

Ravi: Approved for owners.

Sam: Merged main -> https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/commit/0a1b2c3 — tiny sed fix + embedded snippet. Thanks everyone.

docs-bot: PR #3216 closed and link-checker passed in CI. :white_check_mark:

Ava: Thanks all — leaving a quick follow-up in the sprint board to audit shortlinks next week.
